antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 635nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in nephron if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Intense 810nm: high power 2W laser, 370 THz, 10^-15s, single pulse for acute effect targeting NO_synthase in nephron. Study reference: 2025 peer-reviewed paper shows NO modulation at 635nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial ATP_synthase_F0F1 activation.
